details: The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) for June 2026 registered a month-over-month fall of 0.4%, leading the annual inflation rate to slow to 3.5%. This figure came in below the anticipated 3.8%. The softer inflation data reduced expectations for further Federal Reserve interest rate hikes, which is generally seen as bullish for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies. Following the news, Bitcoin surged above $65,000.
title: US Inflation Cools, Boosting Bitcoin Above $65K as Fed Rate Hike Odds Ease

details: The "21st Century ROAD to Housing Act," which recently passed the US House of Representatives with bipartisan support, includes a notable provision. This clause prohibits the Federal Reserve from researching, designing, building, testing, or issuing a Central Bank Digital Currency (CBDC) until at least December 31, 2030.
title: US House Passes Bill Prohibiting Federal Reserve from Issuing CBDC Until 2030
